none: PAS FindID 709113: Roman finger ring with eagle intaglio
contea di ritrovamento: Lancashire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Report on potential Treasure for HM Coroner. 2015 T191, Lancaster area, Lancs. Roman silver finger-ring, entire lower half of hoop missing. The hoop is ovoid in profile and is elliptical in section; it expands and swells to a slightly flattened bezel set with an ovoid intaglio of dark red/brown banded quartz which occupies the central part of the bezel. This is inscribed with a figure of an eagle…
